{{Quote|When I ride my skatecoaster, I brake by rubbing my shoe against the ground.|Stuart Zissu|<ref name="Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four]]''</ref>}}
A '''skatecoaster''' a short, narrow board with two small [[wheel]]s fixed to the bottom of either end, on which an individual could stand to move along a surface or to perform tricks, propelling themselves by occasionally pushing one [[Limb/Legends|foot]] against the ground. Braking was achieved by using frictional forces. Skatecoasters were popular among [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], and the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Stuart Zissu]] owned one.

==Behind the scenes==
Skatecoasters first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Science Adventures]]'' series of educational novels for young adults. They were used as a stand-in for the real-life [[Wikipedia:Skateboard|skateboards]].
